name: project_plan_save
description: Save a project plan draft for user review in the project workspace. Captures the selected team and employee settings. Each edit creates an unconfirmed revision and retains earlier versions.

id.description: Existing plan id for an edit. Omit when creating.

expectedRevision.description: Zero for creation, otherwise latest content revision from project_plan_list.

documentPath.description: Existing UTF-8 plan file inside the main conversation working directory, which must be a Git project. Write the complete plan there with file tools before saving this index.

goal.description: Project goal, constraints and expected delivery.

background.description: Relevant source material and confirmed decisions. An empty array explicitly records that none is supplied.

source.description: Source URL, file path or decision reference.

content.description: Relevant content or sourced summary delivered to each employee.

tasks.description: Work items in execution order, with assigned team members and acceptance criteria.

employeeId.description: Saved employee in the selected team.

instruction.description: Work to perform and expected artifacts.

acceptance.description: Checks and evidence required for subsequent acceptance.

review.description: Optional acceptance by independent employees. Failed or unverifiable checks block downstream work.

rework.description: Optional preauthorized repair of failing acceptance under unchanged criteria. Omit to disable repair.

maxAttempts.description: Positive maximum repair executions for this task across the execution history. Failures and interruptions consume an attempt.

reviewerIds.description: Distinct saved team employees other than the author.

release.description: Continue after all reviewers pass, or wait for workspace user confirmation before continuing.

artifactPaths.description: Nonempty UTF-8 artifact paths within the execution directory. Host verifies decoded-content hashes before release.

downstream.description: Inputs required by downstream nodes. An empty array explicitly means no downstream inputs.

criteria.description: Nonempty individually verifiable requirements with distinct references.

evidence.description: Required evidence references or artifact paths.
